name: Alginates (Gaviscon)
mechanism: Forms viscous gel/raft on stomach contents preventing reflux
dosing: Liquid: 10-20ml after meals and bedtime. Tablets: 2-4 tablets after meals and bedtime
contraindications: Intestinal obstruction, hypercalcaemia (calcium-containing formulations), phenylketonuria (some formulations)
interactions: May reduce absorption of other drugs - give 2h apart from antibiotics/levothyroxine
monitoring: Symptom control, electrolytes if renal impairment (sodium/calcium content)
pharmacokinetics: Local action in GI tract, minimal absorption
clinicalPearls: Very commonly used OTC. Advance formulation more effective. High sodium in some - Gaviscon Advance lower. Safe in pregnancy for reflux
indication: GERD, heartburn, hiatus hernia symptoms, pregnancy-related reflux
